Title: [LSJ] Flurry of Action and Marked Path

Messages.Author: Otto Koskinen
Messages.Body:
Flurry of Action
[Gehenna:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Celerity
[cel] (D) Bleed. If the bleed is successful, draw two cards. Discard
down to your hand size afterward.
[CEL] (D) Bleed. If the bleed is successful, this vampire untaps.

Marked Path
[Sabbat:R, SW:R, CE:PM]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Obfuscate
Only usable after a successful (D) action.
[obf] Put this card on the acting vampire. If this vampire performs a
(D) action against the same Methuselah or his or her minions, this
vampire may burn this card to get +1 stealth.
[OBF] As above, but this vampire may burn this card to get +2 stealth.

---

If a vampire bleeds successfully with inferior Flurry of action, and
draws a Marked path in the 2 cards, can he, after discarding, play the
Marked Path?
